metadata.question: Does the vegetation cover in Robinson Crusoe Island show higher greenness compared to Santa Clara Island in November 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need to compare vegetation greenness between two islands in November 2018 - Use NDVI (Normalized Difference Vegetation Index) as a measure of greenness - Robinson Crusoe Island and Santa Clara Island are part of the Juan Fernández Islands in Chile - Use Sentinel-2 for good spatial resolution and frequent coverage - Time period: November 2018 (2018-11-01 to 2018-11-30) 2. Masking strategy: - Need to mask clouds to get accurate NDVI measurements - Use Sentinel-2 cloud masking 3. Logic: - Calculate mean NDVI for each island - Compare Robinson Crusoe vs Santa Clara - If Robinson Crusoe NDVI > Santa Clara NDVI → A: Yes - Else → B: No - Handle cases where no data or insufficient pixels Let me define the geometries for both islands and implement the analysis. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions robinson_crusoe = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[ [-78.87, -33.63], [-78.82, -33.63], [-78.82, -33.67], [-78.87, -33.67], [-78.87, -33.63] ]]) santa_clara = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[ [-78.95, -33.70], [-78.92, -33.70], [-78.92, -33.72], [-78.95, -33.72], [-78.95, -33.70] ]]) date_range = ['2018-11-01', '2018-11-30'] # 2. import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
robinson_crusoe = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[
    [-78.87, -33.63],
    [-78.82, -33.63],
    [-78.82, -33.67],
    [-78.87, -33.67],
    [-78.87, -33.63]
]])

santa_clara = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[
    [-78.95, -33.70],
    [-78.92, -33.70],
    [-78.92, -33.72],
    [-78.95, -33.72],
    [-78.95, -33.70]
]])

date_range = ['2018-11-01', '2018-11-30']

# 2. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-2
def mask_s2_clouds(image):
    qa = image.select('QA60')
    cloud_bitmask = 1 << 10
    cirrus_bitmask = 1 << 11
    mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloud_bitmask).eq(0).And(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrus_bitmask).eq(0))
    return image.updateMask(mask)

def add_ndvi(image):
    ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI')
    return image.addBands(ndvi)

# Get collections for both islands
s2_rc = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
    .filterDate(date_range[0], date_range[1])
    .filterBounds(robinson_crusoe)
    .map(mask_s2_clouds)
    .map(add_ndvi))

s2_sc = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
    .filterDate(date_range[0], date_range[1])
    .filterBounds(santa_clara)
    .map(mask_s2_clouds)
    .map(add_ndvi))

# Check collection sizes
rc_size = s2_rc.size().getInfo()
sc_size = s2_sc.size().getInfo()

print(f"Robinson Crusoe Images: {rc_size}")
print(f"Santa Clara Images: {sc_size}")

if rc_size == 0 or sc_size == 0:
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # Create median composites
    rc_median = s2_rc.median()
    sc_median = s2_sc.median()
    
    # Calculate mean NDVI and pixel counts
    rc_stats = rc_median.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs=True),
        geometry=robinson_crusoe,
        scale=100,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).getInfo()
    
    sc_stats = sc_median.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs=True),
        geometry=santa_clara,
        scale=100,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).getInfo()
    
    rc_ndvi = rc_stats.get('NDVI')
    sc_ndvi = sc_stats.get('NDVI')
    rc_count = rc_stats.get('NDVI_count', 0)
    sc_count = sc_stats.get('NDVI_count', 0)
    
    print(f"Robinson Crusoe NDVI: {rc_ndvi:.3f}, Pixels: {rc_count}")
    print(f"Santa Clara NDVI: {sc_ndvi:.3f}, Pixels: {sc_count}")
    
    # Validation checks
    if rc_count == 0 or sc_count == 0:
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    elif rc_ndvi is None or sc_ndvi is None or abs(rc_ndvi) > 1 or abs(sc_ndvi) > 1:
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    elif rc_ndvi > sc_ndvi:
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
